cards.name: hero
cards.title: A TikTok group chat in **5 taps**
cards.sub: Inbox, new message, two or more friends, Chat. Up to 32 people, age 16 and up.

steps.title: New message
steps.text: Pencil or plus, at the top.

steps.title: Pick 2+
steps.text: One person is a normal chat.

steps.title: Chat + name
steps.text: Tap Chat, then name the group.

cards.name: photos
cards.title: Up to **9 photos or videos** at once

cards.name: bottom-line
cards.quote: Can’t add someone? **Follow each other first.**
cards.by: And remember: a deleted TikTok message can’t be recovered.
